title: Ahaana Krishna Marries 'Lokah' Cinematographer Nimish Ravi in Kerala Wedding
excerpt: The Malayalam actor and 'Lokah' cinematographer tied the knot on September 13 in an intimate Kovalam ceremony, announcing it on Instagram with the line: 'Met you at 20, Married you at 30.'
body:
• Malayalam actor Ahaana Krishna and cinematographer Nimish Ravi married on September 13, 2026, at the Taj Green Cove Resort in Kovalam, Kerala, announcing the news on Instagram on September 15.
  • "Met you at 20, Married you at 30!" Ahaana wrote, calling Nimish her "best friend, boy friend, partner, soul-mate" and now husband; Nimish posted, "My best friend, now my wife. 13 September 2026."
  • Ahaana wore a traditional gold-and-red pattu saree with gold temple jewellery, designed by Joel Jacob Mathew, which she said she hopes to pass on to her children and grandchildren; Nimish wore a cream suit with gold-framed glasses.
  • Congratulations poured in from across the Malayalam film industry — including Manju Warrier, Anupama Parameswaran, Malavika Mohanan, Amala Paul and Basil Joseph — with a reception held in Thiruvananthapuram on September 15.

Malayalam actor Ahaana Krishna has married cinematographer Nimish Ravi, one of the most in-demand directors of photography in South Indian cinema. The couple tied the knot on September 13, 2026, in an intimate ceremony at the Taj Green Cove Resort in Kovalam, Kerala, and shared the first photographs on Instagram on September 15.

"Met you at 20, Married you at 30! My best friend, boy friend, partner, soul-mate, comfort pillow, cup cake and now husband!"

— Ahaana Krishna, on Instagram

Ahaana's post included an old photograph of the couple from their 20s alongside wedding pictures, tracing a journey from friendship to marriage. "With you, my heart always beats slow, steady and just right. To growing old together and building a world we can call our own… here's to being same team for life and beyond!" she wrote. Nimish shared a photograph of the couple with fireworks in the background, captioning it, "My best friend, now my wife. 13 September 2026," according to reports.

An intimate Kerala ceremony

The wedding took place at the Taj Green Cove Resort, a location Ahaana said held special meaning for the couple because of memories they had already shared there. She wore a traditional gold-and-red pattu saree paired with gold temple jewellery, revealing she had a particular shade of red in mind before finalising the design with Joel Jacob Mathew's label. She added that she plans to pass the saree down to her children and grandchildren. Nimish opted for a cream suit with gold-framed glasses. The couple's posts used the hashtags #AmmuNimmu and #WeGotMarried, and Ahaana thanked the teams behind the planning, photography, design, makeup and florals who had worked with her for months.

According to reports, celebrations continued with a reception in Thiruvananthapuram on September 15. Actor Rishab Shetty and his wife Pragathi were among those reportedly expected, as Nimish is set to collaborate with Shetty on the upcoming film Jai Hanuman.

Who they are

Ahaana Krishna is the eldest daughter of actor Krishna Kumar and Sindhu Krishna. She made her acting debut in 2014 with Rajeev Ravi's Njan Steve Lopez and has since appeared in films including Njandukalude Nattil Oridavela, Adi, Nancy Rani, Pathinettam Padi and Lokah Chapter 1: Chandra.

Nimish Ravi made his debut as a cinematographer with the 2019 film Luca — which starred Tovino Thomas alongside Ahaana — and has since shot films such as Kurup, Rorschach, King of Kotha and Lucky Baskhar. His recent credits include Lokah Chapter 1: Chandra and Suriya's Vishwanath & Sons, which also marked his Tamil cinema debut. According to Pinkvilla, Ahaana reportedly met Nimish while filming Luca.

Industry showers wishes

Wishes flooded in from across the Malayalam film industry. Anupama Parameswaran, Rajisha Vijayan, Malavika Mohanan, Samyuktha, Meenaakshi Chaudhary, Manju Warrier, Pearle Maaney, Saniya Iyappan, Basil Joseph, Venkitesh VP, Parvathy Thiruvothu, Radhika Sarathkumar and Amala Paul were among those who congratulated the couple. Ahaana's sister Ishaani Krishna reacted with "finally." Cultural Affairs Minister P.C. Vishnunath also shared a picture with the newlyweds from the Sree Padmanabhaswamy Temple, according to reports.

A relationship kept mostly private

Unlike her younger sister Diya Krishna, whose relationship and wedding were more openly documented on social media, Ahaana had largely kept her relationship with Nimish away from the public eye until recently. Speculation about the couple had circulated for weeks before the announcement, and the Instagram reveal on September 15 was effectively their relationship going public — and their wedding announcement in one.

Malayalam cinema weddings continue to draw enormous attention from fans in Kerala and across the diaspora, and the couple's decade-long friendship-to-marriage arc has struck a chord on social media, where the posts have drawn hundreds of thousands of views.
